result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: the restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' is truncated mid-character ('Tokumaru Rameı') even though there appears to be enough horizontal space before the rating. A few other elements are clipped at screen edges, which may be intentional carousel behavior but could be improved for clarity.

issues.description: The restaurant title under the ramen card reads 'Tokumaru Rameı' — the final 'n' is clipped mid-character, despite there appearing to be ample whitespace between the title and the 4.8 rating on the right.
issues.suggestion: Fix the text container width or truncation logic so the full name 'Tokumaru Ramen' renders; if truncation is required, use a proper ellipsis (…) instead of clipping mid-glyph.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant name is cut off as 'Trattoria Piccol' with no ellipsis, making it look accidentally clipped rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add an ellipsis for truncated names or add right-edge padding/peek styling so it's clear the row scrolls horizontally.

issues.description: The last category chip in the filter row (right of 'Healthy') is cut off at the screen edge showing only a sliver, which looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Adjust spacing so a partially visible chip shows enough content to signal horizontal scrolling, or add a fade/gradient at the edge.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom is cut off by the tab bar with no visible title or details, and its bottom corners are clipped abruptly.
issues.suggestion: This is likely normal scroll behavior, but consider adding bottom content padding so cards don't sit flush against the navigation bar mid-scroll.
